work_package: FF3 (Phase C wave 4): FeatureFinderIdentificationAlgorithm and FeatureFinderAlgorithmMetaboIdent
method: Port of FEATUREFINDER/FeatureFinderIdentificationAlgorithm and FeatureFinderAlgorithmMetaboIdent on the OpenSWATH classes of the other lanes. The three class-test sections are transcribed with their literals; the retained outputs of TOPP_FeatureFinderIdentification_1/_3/_5 (and the 22-peptide summary) and TOPP_FeatureFinderMetaboIdent_1 are replayed through the files and compared with the upstream FuzzyDiff rule. An oracle driver linking the executed C++ Release build runs both algorithms on the TOPP inputs and on variants (seeds, offset peptides, decoys, score cutoff, CalcMass shift, FAIMS, ion mobility, adducts, isotope distributions, RT ranges, overlapping targets, contract skips) and on the extractor alone, and prints every feature, library entry and candidate as %.17g records; the Rust tests replay those records bit for bit. The driver ran twice in fresh processes with a clean environment; standard output, standard error and exit code are byte-identical.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed C++ Release on ibminode06: tests/feature_finder_identification_oracle.rs, and the retained TOPP outputs of tests/feature_finder_identification_topp.rs); tier 3 (transcribed class-test literals); tier 4 (native guards and derived invariants)
native_implementation: src/analysis/openswath/stats_helpers.rs and scoring.rs (library scores sum in Eigen's reduction order)
